assumptions: ASSUMPTION: slope limit 25 deg (cells steeper are blocked)
ASSUMPTION: walking speed = Tobler (1993) x 0.6 for suit and Mars gravity
ASSUMPTION: cost weights slope 4, roughness 0.5, AI hazard 4, science 0.5
AI hazard layer: model\out\hazard.bin; it raises the cost of a cell and never blocks one (see model/MODEL_CARD.md)
Planner ai-hazard-v1: pipeline/planner_basic.py plus the AI hazard term
Science values are relative CRISM browse-product signals, not mineral amounts
